mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, name, basic_class, sort
mapper.select:
SELECT s.id, s.name, s.sort, s.basic_class, s.product_classification_enum, sm.keyword, sm.spec_index, sc.classify_id, sc.classify_name, sc.path, matchName.matching_name FROM sys_steel_classification s LEFT JOIN sys_steel_classification_match sm ON sm.steel_id = s.id and sm.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_steel_classify_link sc ON sc.steel_id = s.id and sc.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_steel_class_spec_name_link matchName ON matchName.steel_id = s.id and matchName.bool_delete_enum = 0 where s.bool_delete_enum = 0
and s.id IN
#{classificationId}
ORDER BY s.sort, s.id

SELECT steel.id steel_id, steel.`name` steel_name, steel.basic_class basicClassId, link.classify_id classify_id, link.classify_name classify_name FROM sys_steel_classification steel LEFT JOIN sys_steel_classify_link link ON steel.id = link.steel_id AND link.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE steel.bool_delete_enum = 0

select sc.id, sc.part_type, sc.matching_names, cd.name, cm.id steelId, cm.keyword spec, pl.id linkId, pl.process_id, pl.sequence, p.name linkName, pl.node_time, p.product_type, p.type from sys_steel_classification sc left join mes_section_warehouse_config_detail cd on sc.section_warehouse_config_id = cd.id and cd.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_steel_classification_match cm on sc.id = cm.steel_id and cm.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join mes_building_product_process_link pl on sc.id = pl.class_id and pl.bool_delete_enum = 0 and pl.product_type = 1 left join mes_building_process p on pl.process_id = p.id and p.bool_delete_enum = 0
